title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Senior OutSystems Engineer
description:
Senior OutSystems Engineer


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.


This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.


What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies

Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows


What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users


This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .

  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.

  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;

  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Java/Kotlin)

Location: Brazil, Costa Rica, Colombia

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Hourly, no benefits, candidate responsible for taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Working Hours: 40 hours per week


Role Overview

  • Senior Software Engineer on a newly formed Item Domain team (Sales & Retail: Pricing, Pay, and Merch Tools) for an authenticated luxury resale marketplace.
  • Focus on rebuilding core item data systems (pricing, merchandising, enrichment) through a mix of greenfield development and legacy system integration.
  • This is a high-impact role contributing to a long-term transformation of core data systems, leveraging modern backend technologies and AI-assisted development.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering leadership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing to company-wide initiatives.
  • Develop backend services and internal tooling using JVM (Java, Kotlin) as a core focus, along with existing systems in Python and Ruby.
  • Build and support web applications for shoppers and operators (listing, enrichment, merchandising).
  • Work with technologies including React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB.
  • Contribute to technical decisions shaping future software systems and architecture.
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Collaborate through pair programming and support onboarding when needed.
  • Deploy user-facing code to production responsibly.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineering leadership, and stakeholders across regions.
  • Ensure observability and reliability by learning from metrics and incidents and maintaining systems.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering workflows.
  • Continuously learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5+ years of strong backend software engineering experience.
  • Experience with Java or another backend language, with willingness to work with Kotlin (JVM-based systems).
  • Experience building and maintaining production-ready, reliable, and secure systems.
  • Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong communication skills with product, stakeholders, and engineering peers (fluent English required ).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with distributed and US-based teams.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and deployment tools.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on user impact and business context.
  • Openness to using AI-assisted coding tools in daily development workflows.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with JVM services (Java, Kotlin) in production environments.
  • Experience with Python or Ruby.
  • Experience with web technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React.
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or managed AI APIs into backend or internal tools.
  • Experience with eCommerce platforms.
  • Experience working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response in production.


What We’re Looking For

  • Backend-strong engineer (full-stack experience is a plus).
  • Adaptable and fast learner with flexibility across technologies.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving, and greenfield environments .
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborative team player.
  • Open to AI-assisted development workflows and modern engineering practices.

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times.
  • Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud.
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes.
  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Machine Learning, MLOps, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica.
  • Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso.
  • Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência.
  • Conhecimento em governança de modelos, explicabilidade, documentação, auditoria, gestão de risco, qualidade de dados e compliance.


Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em LLMOps, RAG, agentes de IA, gateways de LLMs, avaliação de respostas, controle de custos e observabilidade para IA generativa.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA generativa e integração com LLMs, como LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM.
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

title: Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.


A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.


Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.


Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:

• Radares

• ECDIS

• Satcoms

• Rádios HF e VHF

• GPS

• Girobússola

• Pilotos automáticos

• Sirenes

• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.

• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About LINES


LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.


We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.



What you'll do


  • Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style)
  • Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization
  • Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients
  • Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability
  • Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency
  • Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database
  • Design data models for high-write, real-time systems
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction
  • Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows
  • Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower



What we expect


  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset
  • Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization
  • Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs
  • Designs for scale even when the system is still small
  • Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it
  • Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar
  • Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency
  • Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering
  • Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities
  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality



Tech stack


  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript
  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare
  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)
  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Nice to have


  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces
  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience
  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)
  • Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video)
  • React Native or Expo

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Global Hubspot Sales Operations
description:
Do you enjoy working inside systems, fixing what’s broken, and making things run correctly?


Can you take messy, inconsistent data and turn it into something accurate, reliable, and usable?


Do you get satisfaction from building workflows, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks?


Final question: When faced with a complex challenge, do you get excited, or run away?



At Crisp, we’re on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


We operate with the intensity of a championship team, where every player is expected to bring their best, own their outcomes, and drive results.


We’re hiring a HubSpot Sales Data Operations team member to support our Sales organization by owning data accuracy, workflow execution, and system reliability inside HubSpot.


This role exists for one reason:


…to ensure that our HubSpot data is accurate, our sales workflows function correctly, and our Sales team can operate without friction, enabling leadership to make decisions based on reliable data and drive revenue growth. If data is wrong, decisions are wrong. This role ensures that never happens.




** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch. If you have any questions, please contact me at .




Who You Are:


  • You are highly detail-oriented and process-driven.
  • You take ownership of problems and solve them without being handheld.
  • You move with urgency and do not let tasks sit idle.
  • You are highly experienced being the HubSpot expert and troubleshooting issues independently.
  • You are not afraid to “get your hands dirty” fixing data and cleaning systems.
  • You communicate clearly and directly.
  • You can handle a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with strong personalities.
  • You do not make excuses, rather, you find solutions.


What You’ll Do:

HubSpot Data Ownership & Accuracy

  • Own data cleanliness and accuracy inside HubSpot across the entire sales pipeline
  • Identify and fix incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data
  • Ensure all sales data reflects reality and can be trusted for decision-making

Workflow & Automation Execution

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot HubSpot workflows and automations
  • Ensure lead routing, deal movement, and task assignments function correctly
  • Reduce friction for Sales by simplifying and optimizing workflows

Sales Pipeline & Reporting Support

  • Maintain and support the integrity of the deal pipeline (lead → calls → close)
  • Ensure accurate tracking of sales KPIs and performance metrics
  • Support and maintain integrations feeding into reporting systems (e.g., “Daily Dash”)

System Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Diagnose issues across HubSpot, integrations, and workflows
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales team members to identify root causes
  • Implement solutions quickly without waiting for direction

Process Documentation & Training

  • Build and maintain clear, step-by-step process documentation (“point-and-click” SOPs)
  • Train Sales team members on correct system usage
  • Ensure new hires are properly set up and onboarded in HubSpot and related tools

Quality Control & System Integrity

  • Ensure all workflows, automations, and data structures are functioning correctly
  • Continuously monitor for errors, inconsistencies, and breakdowns
  • Escalate issues quickly and proactively

Our Requirements Are Pretty Straightforward. To Qualify You Must:

  • 2+ years experience managing a company’s HubSpot instance for Sales
  • Strong understanding of sales pipelines and funnel stages
  • Proven experience building workflows and automations
  • Strong problem-solving ability and resourcefulness
  • High level of proficiency in Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, data handling)
  • Ability to work independently and execute without constant direction
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours consistently
  • Ability to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Bonus:
  • HubSpot certifications
  • Experience with the following integrations: Zapier, Coefficient
  • Familiarity with sales tools such as Zoom Phone or similar systems
  • Exposure to AI tools or automation platforms




In Return, Here’s Our Promise to You:

At Crisp, we don’t just hire people: we build A-players.

  • Clear expectations. You will know exactly what success looks like.
  • High-impact work. Your work directly affects revenue decisions.
  • Fast-paced environment. Work moves quickly and decisively.
  • Growth opportunity. Strong performance leads to expanded responsibility.
  • Ownership culture. You are trusted to solve problems and execute.

Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, not necessarily the best lawyers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in.

Our mission is to level the playing field, equipping these firms with the tools, strategies, and support they need to stand out and win.


We empower law firms to not only grow their businesses but also make a bigger impact — delivering better outcomes and driving positive change.


At Crisp, we’re here to ensure that the best law firms, no matter their size, have a fighting chance to lead, serve, and transform their communities.


By empowering our law firm clients to succeed, we’re not just building stronger businesses; we’re creating a ripple effect of positive change that impacts lives, families, and communities across the country.


About Crisp:


Crisp is an incredibly fast-moving, high-growth company (1470%+ growth in 3 years) with a laser focus on delivering the absolute best legal marketing and business coaching services on the market today.


Check out what we are about here:


We’re all about working hard and staying humble. In the spirit of humble bragging, here are some of our awards and accolades:

  • Crisp Founder and CEO Michael Mogill named EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® 2023
  • Named to Inc. 5000 List of Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 7-Years (2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017)
  • Atlanta’s fastest-growing companies 9 years in a row (2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016)
  • Recognized as Atlanta’s Best Places to Work
  • Creators and annual hosts of the Crisp Game Changers Summit, the largest and most ambitious law firm growth conference on Earth
  • Published the legal industry’s best-selling marketing book
  • Host of the most listened-to podcast in the legal industry
  • Featured in Forbes, The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, Yahoo, and The Huffington Post


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will be part of building and improving core sales infrastructure
  • You will gain exposure to high-level sales operations and systems
  • You will be pushed to grow and perform at a high level



If you’re looking for a job that’s boring and easy, you won’t find that here. We put 110% into everything we do. Greatness is achieved through hard work, discipline, and sacrifice, and we’re determined to be great.


If you want to solve real problems, own systems, and operate at a high level — apply.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

Reach Surgical, a Genesis Medtech Company, is a leading minimally-invasive surgical device manufacturer and supplier, committed to serving high-quality products to healthcare practitioners and patients worldwide. We deliver advanced technology and cost effective minimally-invasive surgical products to medical institutions and provide patients with reliable and economical treatment solutions.

You will conduct market research including customers and competitors’ activities and formulate and execute market development strategies. In addition, you will develop and build long-lasting relationships with stakeholders including distributors and healthcare professionals and obtain feedback on our products to internal stakeholders.


1. Development and Execution of Sales Plans


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Define clear and measurable overseas sales goals, develop corresponding action plans, and execute them effectively to meet company objectives.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support regional marketing activities, leverage internal and external resources efficiently, and enhance overall customer value.
  • Decision-Making: Maintain a deep understanding of regional market conditions; identify emerging opportunities and potential challenges to make informed and timely decisions.


2. KOL (Key Opinion Leader) Management


  • Database Development : Establish and maintain a comprehensive overseas KOL information archive.
  • Customer Insight : Analyze the potential and specific needs of KOLs to develop targeted engagement plans.
  • Relationship Management : Strategically allocate resources to build, strengthen, and sustain long-term cooperative relationships with KOLs.


3. Distributor Management


  • Distributor Development : Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment.
  • Performance Support & Training: Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes.
  • Channel Optimization : Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network.


Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Prospecção e visita de clientes potenciais, identificando novas oportunidades e buscando o crescimento da receita;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais dentro de cada cliente para captação de novos projetos apoiando sempre de forma consultiva para melhor integração da TI ao negócio;
  • Elaboração de propostas comerciais;
  • Negociação de taxas com clientes e profissionais para atingir o target necessário para fechamento do negócio de acordo com as metas estabelecidas;
  • Apoio aos clientes ativos nas rotinas necessárias para que os processos internos sejam atendidos;

title: Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times.
  • Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud.
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes.
  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Machine Learning, MLOps, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica.
  • Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso.
  • Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência.
  • Conhecimento em governança de modelos, explicabilidade, documentação, auditoria, gestão de risco, qualidade de dados e compliance.


Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em LLMOps, RAG, agentes de IA, gateways de LLMs, avaliação de respostas, controle de custos e observabilidade para IA generativa.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA generativa e integração com LLMs, como LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM.
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English
