title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location : Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Turkey, Vietnam


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Analista de Customer Success Pleno | Produto RH
description:

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Customer Success II para atuar na implantação (onboarding) de clientes da vertical de Capital Humano, com foco em execução de projetos, alinhamento entre stakeholders e geração de valor desde os primeiros marcos da jornada.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Identificar riscos, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria durante a execução, propondo planos de ação;
  • Monitorar indicadores de sucesso como adoção, engajamento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Comercial), garantindo fluidez nas entregas;
  • Garantir registros e acompanhamento estruturado das interações e demandas dos clientes;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos, trazendo visão crítica e sugestões baseadas na operação.

  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Onboarding ou Atendimento ao Cliente B2B;
  • Vivência prática com gestão de projetos (planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de cronogramas);
  • Experiência com múltiplos stakeholders e condução de agendas estruturadas;

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;

Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:

  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:

title: Analista Financeiro de Orçamento Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA


A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.


Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!


ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Location: Dalian, China (initial phase) | Brazil Offshore (subsequent operations)

Rights to Work: Brazil

Employment Type: Contractor / Rotational


Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Supervisor to join a major offshore oil and gas project, initially based at a shipyard in Dalian, China during the construction and pre-commissioning phase, before mobilising to Brazil for offshore operations. The successful candidate will play a critical role in overseeing mechanical installation, inspection, and commissioning activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, and client requirements.


Construction & Commissioning Phase (Dalian, China)

  • Supervise and coordinate all mechanical installation activities at the shipyard, including rotating equipment, static equipment, piping systems, and structural mechanical components
  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, and equipment data sheets
  • Monitor contractor and vendor progress against project schedules, flagging deviations and driving corrective actions
  • Conduct daily site walks and formal inspections, ensuring work is executed in accordance with approved procedures and specifications
  • Attend and participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests) and SAT (Site Acceptance Tests) for mechanical equipment
  • Interface with QA/QC teams to ensure all mechanical work packages are correctly documented, punch-listed, and closed out
  • Liaise with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to resolve technical queries and NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) in a timely manner
  • Support Pre-Commissioning and Commissioning activities in preparation for sail-away


Offshore Operations Phase (Brazil)

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and operational activities in accordance with the approved maintenance management system
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA) and applicable international standards (API, ASME, ISO)
  • Lead and coordinate mechanical shutdown and turnaround activities
  • Monitor equipment condition and performance, recommending preventive and corrective maintenance strategies
  • Support HSE initiatives and enforce permit-to-work systems (PTW) at all times



Requirements

  • Mechanical supervision experience in offshore or FPSO projects
  • Proven shipyard construction experience, ideally in Asia
  • Strong background in rotating and static equipment
  • Proficiency in engineering drawings, international codes (ASME, API, ABNT), and CMMS platforms
  • Degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent trade qualification)
  • Valid offshore survival certification (OPITO/HUET); NR-10, NR-33, NR-37 required or to be obtained
  • Fluency in Portuguese mandatory; working English essential

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus

title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Data Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

Auxis is a U.S.-founded consulting and business outsourcing firm (est. 1997) that helps organizations optimize and transform their operations. We specialize in areas such as technology, finance, human resources, automation, and digital transformation.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Oracle PCM Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of profitability and cost management solutions within the Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem.

This role requires a strong mix of functional finance knowledge + technical EPM expertise, with ownership over solution architecture and client-facing delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution design and architecture for Oracle PCM implementations
  • Define cost allocation models, driver-based costing, and profitability frameworks
  • Work closely with finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable solutions
  • Oversee data integrations, calculations, and model performance optimization
  • Ensure best practices in metadata design, hierarchies, and dimensional modeling
  • Support and guide teams during month-end and planning cycles
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across data, calculations, and reporting
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor for junior team members


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience with Oracle EPM, including strong exposure to PCM
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Cost allocation methodologies
  • Profitability analysis frameworks
  • Financial modeling and reporting
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Oracle PCMCS / EPCM
  • Smart View
  • Data Integration / Data Management
  • Metadata and hierarchy design


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in consulting or managed services environments
  • Exposure to multi-client / multi-project delivery
  • Oracle EPM certifications (nice to have)


Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and finance stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment


Work Expectations

  • Support North American business hours when required
  • Flexibility during planning and financial cycles
  • Ownership of delivery quality and SLAs

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision.
  • Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs.
  • Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance.
  • Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations.
  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won’t be accepted.

  • Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de novos negócios II
description:
Descrição da vaga

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Mapear e analisar oportunidades de projetos futuros no segmento de transmissão de energia.
  • Avaliar documentos setoriais relacionados ao planejamento da expansão da transmissão no Brasil.
  • Contribuir para a elaboração e atualização do planejamento estratégico da área de transmissão.
  • Estruturar novos negócios e apoiar a definição de estratégias de participação em projetos e leilões.
  • Realizar análises de mercado, incluindo avaliação de concorrência, tendências e oportunidades no setor.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Engenharia ou Economia.
  • Visão estratégica aplicada ao setor elétrico, com compreensão da dinâmica de expansão da transmissão.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento ou avaliação de projetos no segmento de transmissão de energia.
  • Conhecimento do modelo regulatório e do ambiente de negócios da transmissão no Brasil.
  • Domínio de ferramentas computacionais, com ênfase em:
  • Excel avançado
  • Estruturação e manipulação de bases de dados
  • Ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI)

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência na análise de documentos setoriais relacionados à expansão da transmissão, como Relatórios R, PET/PELP, POTEE, PAR/PEL e editais de leilões.
  • Experiência em análise econômico-financeira de projetos.
  • Conhecimento na estruturação e estimativa de CAPEX e cronograma de projetos de transmissão.
  • Capacidade de condução e coordenação de projetos multidisciplinares.


Informações adicionais

Benefícios:


Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. title: Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer — JUDIT

A JUDIT está construindo a infraestrutura de dados jurídicos mais avançada do Brasil.

Nosso objetivo é transformar o acesso a dados judiciais em algo escalável, estruturado e acionável — criando a base para agentes de IA e produtos que redefinem como empresas analisam risco jurídico.

Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos, trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e construir sistemas distribuídos de verdade, essa vaga é para você..


O desafio

Você vai atuar diretamente na evolução da nossa arquitetura orientada a eventos, que processa milhões de requisições e integra dezenas de fontes de dados (tribunais, crawlers, datalake, etc).

Isso inclui:

  • Construção e evolução de microserviços críticos
  • Processamento assíncrono com alto throughput
  • Normalização e enriquecimento de dados jurídicos em escala
  • Evolução do nosso datalake com centenas de milhões de registros
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines resilientes e observáveis
  • Base para agentes de IA especializados no domínio jurídico 


Stack & Arquitetura

Você vai trabalhar com uma stack moderna, focada em escala e resiliência:

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Python (workers e pipelines)
  • AWS (Lambda, ECS, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, ElastiCache/Redis, S3)
  • MongoDB (Atlas) como principal banco
  • Arquitetura event-driven (SNS + SQS)
  • Datalake próprio com processamento massivo
  • Integrações intensivas via APIs e crawling


O que buscamos

Um perfil realmente sênior, com autonomia técnica e capacidade de decisão:

  • Forte experiência com sistemas distribuídos
  • Domínio de arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Experiência com processamento assíncrono e filas
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente AWS)
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados (Big Data / pipelines)
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas complexos em produção
  • Mentalidade de dono (ownership real de serviços)

Diferenciais importantes:

  • Experiência com web scraping / crawling em escala
  • Conhecimento em machine learning / IA aplicada
  • Experiência com observabilidade e performance tuning
  • Background em sistemas críticos (financeiro, jurídico, cobrança, etc)


Modelo

  • Remoto (Brasil)
  • Full-time

title: Sales Director – Institutional Stablecoin Sales (Hunter)
description:
Job Title: Sales Director – Institutional Stablecoin Sales (Hunter)


Location: Global / GCC (Preferred: UAE or Bahrain)

Company: AlloyX Group – AXCoin


⸻


Role Overview


We are seeking a high-performing, deal-driven Sales Director to lead institutional sales for AXCoin. This is a pure hunter role, focused on acquiring and scaling relationships with crypto exchanges, DeFi platforms, institutional trading firms, and global payment PSPs.


The ideal candidate brings an existing network, active pipeline, and proven ability to close high-value partnerships that drive stablecoin issuance, circulation, and transaction volume.


⸻


Key Responsibilities


1. Business Acquisition (Primary Focus)


* Originate, develop, and close new institutional partnerships across:

  * Tier 1 & Tier 2 crypto exchanges

  * DeFi protocols & liquidity platforms

  * Payment Service Providers (PSPs) and on/off-ramp partners

* Drive stablecoin adoption, listings, and integrations across partner ecosystems

* Convert existing relationships into live, revenue-generating partnerships within 3–6 months


2. Pipeline & Revenue Ownership


* Build and maintain a robust, active pipeline of high-quality institutional prospects

* Own and deliver against aggressive revenue and volume targets, including:

  * Stablecoin issuance growth

  * Transaction volume (on-chain & off-chain)

  * Active partner count and wallet activity

* Track and optimize conversion rates from lead → deal → volume


3. Strategic Partnerships & Distribution


* Structure and negotiate commercial agreements (liquidity, listing, distribution, yield partnerships)

* Identify and execute joint go-to-market strategies with partners

* Collaborate with product and treasury teams to align liquidity, pricing, and incentives


4. Market Leadership & Relationship Management


* Build strong C-level relationships (CEO, COO, Head of Trading, Head of Partnerships)

* Position AXCoin as a trusted institutional-grade stablecoin partner

* Represent the company at global crypto, fintech, and payments forums


⸻


Candidate Profile


Must-Have Experience


* 7 to 10 years in business development / institutional sales within:

  * Crypto / digital assets

  * Payments / PSPs

  * Fintech / trading ecosystems

* Proven hunter track record: consistently closing large, complex deals

* Existing relationships and active pipeline with:

  * Crypto exchanges (centralized & decentralized)

  * DeFi ecosystems

  * Institutional liquidity providers / market makers

  * Global PSPs and payment networks


Critical Capabilities


* Deep understanding of:

  * Stablecoins, liquidity flows, and token economics

  * On/off-ramp infrastructure and settlement rails

  * Institutional crypto trading and treasury needs

* Strong commercial acumen with ability to structure win-win, scalable partnerships

* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, build-and-scale environment


Leadership & Personal Traits


* Pure hunter mindset – relentless, proactive, and target-driven

* Highly credible with executive presence and strong negotiation skills

* Self-starter with ability to open doors and close deals independently

* Global mindset with strong cross-border relationship experience


⸻


Why Join AlloyX / AXCoin


* Opportunity to shape and scale a next-generation institutional stablecoin

* Work alongside a high-caliber leadership team with global reach

* Direct impact on building institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure

  • * Competitive compensation with performance-driven incentives

title: Travel Consultant and Sales Manager
description:
About Us

Dehouche is a leading provider of luxury tailor-made travel to South America, specialising in unforgettable journeys for a discerning clientele. From custom-built wilderness camps to luxury city hotel buyouts and \"money can't buy\" experiences, we pride ourselves on exceptional service and creating memories that last a lifetime.

The Opportunity

We're growing our Rio de Janeiro team and hiring for two positions:

  • Travel Consultant - a senior sales role focused on converting enquiries into bookings and building lasting client relationships.
  • Sales Manager - a senior consultant who also leads, develops, and drives the performance of our consultant team.

Both roles share the same DNA: a highly personalised, authentic approach to selling, and a natural talent for understanding and anticipating client needs. If you're motivated by clients thanking you for the trip of a lifetime, we want to hear from you.

Travel Consultant - What You'll Do

  • Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings by crafting bespoke itineraries that genuinely excite clients.
  • Consult with clients to uncover their aspirations, budget, and motivations, and translate those into compelling proposals.
  • Pitch and close confidently, handling objections and guiding clients to a decision.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships that drive repeat business and referrals.
  • Negotiate rates and added value with suppliers to keep our product competitively priced without compromising quality.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on destination developments, new openings, and emerging experiences across the region.

Sales Manager - What You'll Do

In addition to everything above, you'll:

  • Lead and develop our team of travel consultants, coaching on consultative selling, proposal craft, and closing.
  • Own the team's pipeline and forecast: track conversion, identify bottlenecks, and intervene early.
  • Set, review, and drive individual and team revenue targets.
  • Act as a senior point of escalation on complex or high-value enquiries.
  • Partner with leadership on commercial strategy, pricing, and supplier negotiations.
  • Help recruit, onboard, and shape the next generation of our team.

What We're Looking For (Both Roles)

You're a seasoned travel sales professional with a strong track record of selling high-value travel and consistently hitting, and exceeding, revenue targets. You know how to move a client from \"interested\" to \"booked\".

You're a natural closer. Confident pitching, comfortable talking about price, and able to create urgency without ever feeling pushy.

You have your finger on the pulse of South America: what's new, what's exciting, what clients can't find anywhere else.

You're commercially minded. You understand margin, negotiate well with suppliers, and price trips competitively while maintaining the level of luxury synonymous with our brand.

Your attention to detail is excellent. The trips you sell are executed flawlessly, and your written correspondence is consistently polished.

You're a team player. You share ideas freely and build strong relationships with clients, guides, and colleagues alike.

Additionally for the Sales Manager

  • Demonstrable experience leading or mentoring a sales team, with examples of how you've lifted individual or team performance.
  • Comfortable with numbers: pipeline reporting, forecasting, and conversion analysis.
  • The judgement to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let your team run.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in travel sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Knowledge of South America as a destination is essential. Latin America and the Caribbean a plus.
  • Native-level English. Portuguese, Spanish, or other languages a plus.
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Resilient, self-motivated, and genuinely passionate about travel.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Rio de Janeiro.

How to Apply

Email your CV, along with a short note telling us which role you're applying for and why, to .

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto:

Busca-se profissional para atuação como Analista de Dados Sênior em projetos estratégicos, com forte capacidade analítica, visão de negócio e profundo domínio de Power BI / Fabric , apto a atuar de ponta a ponta em iniciativas analíticas complexas, influenciando decisões estratégicas e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time.


Especialidades e domínio técnico em Power BI

  • DAX avançado : construção de métricas complexas, cálculo de KPIs, otimização de performance e boas práticas de escrita.
  • Power Query : transformação, limpeza e integração de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes.
  • Linguagem M : desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts avançados para ingestão e transformação de dados.
  • Row-Level Security (RLS) : definição e implementação de regras de segurança e governança de acesso aos dados.
  • Data Visualization (Dataviz) : criação de dashboards claros, intuitivos e orientados à tomada de decisão, aplicando princípios de storytelling e UX em dados.
  • Modelagem semântica no Power BI : relacionamento entre tabelas, cardinalidade, direção de filtros e otimização do modelo.


Perfil técnico esperado

  • Sólida experiência em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos , com foco em geração de valor para o negócio.
  • Atuação como referência técnica , com experiência em mentoria, revisão de entregas e evolução de analistas .
  • Experiência na definição e implementação de estratégias analíticas , alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake).
  • Forte experiência no levantamento, entendimento e validação de requisitos de negócio , traduzindo necessidades em soluções analíticas escaláveis.
  • Vivência com Big Data , incluindo consumo e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Data Warehouses .
  • Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouses (ex.: Onelake, Azure Data Lake, Databricks ou similares).
  • Atuação em ambientes de nuvem (Azure , AWS, ou similares).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e influência , com capacidade de traduzir dados em insights estratégicos para diferentes públicos.


Escopo de atuação

  • Conduzir o levantamento, validação e refinamento dos requisitos de negócio junto às áreas usuárias.
  • Definir, validar e evoluir a modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e física).
  • Liderar projetos analíticos end-to-end , da concepção à entrega e sustentação.
  • Atuar em projeto de Migração para Power BI/Fabric
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de análise de dados e visualização em Power BI.
  • Atuar em parceria com líderes de negócio para identificar oportunidades de análise e melhoria de processos .
  • Construir e apresentar dashboards, insights e recomendações executivas para stakeholders.
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados , promovendo boas práticas analíticas no time.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Senior OutSystems Engineer
description:
Senior OutSystems Engineer


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.


This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.


What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies

Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows


What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users


This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.
